literal_meaning: পাতা ঝরার বা ভিড়ের মৃদু শব্দের অনুকরণ (onomatopoeia for rustling or murmuring sound)
figurative_meaning_en: Indicating a state of being completely full or packed without gaps
example_sentences_in_bangla: স্টেডিয়ামটি খচাখচ ভর্তি হয়ে গেছে দর্শকদের সাথে।
বাজারে খচাখচ করে উঠেছে লোকজনের ভিড়।
example_sentences_in_english: The stadium was khachakhach full with spectators.
The market buzzed khachakhach with the crowd of people.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in modern Bengali to describe crowded or lively scenes.
